items.q: Yeah, Al Grey and all of them. The same personnel, but that drummer changed the whole complexion.

ctx.x: Yeah, Al Grey and all of them. The same personnel, but that drummer changed the whole complexion. So they didn't keep him too long. Right after that they got Butch Miles.
